title: Canary Terraform upgrade + state-migration checklist and CI safety workflow for Private VPCs
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Introduce a guarded, observable CI workflow for performing Terraform module and provider upgrades across Private (VPC) deployments. The work includes: a canary apply process to a single staging workspace, automated compatibility checks for state and resource schema changes, explicit state-migration hooks with dry-run validations, a change-risk score computed from resource-graph deltas, and automated health probes and rollback hooks post-apply. The CI pipeline will surface failures early via static IaC scanning (Checkov + Terrascan), a custom dry-plan analyzer, and runtime health gating to prevent promotion to production workspaces if regressions or service degradations are detected.
acceptance_criteria: Canary apply job that runs in a dedicated staging workspace and deploys a module upgrade without affecting production workspaces
Dry-run analyzer that flags potential breaking state migrations with rationale and remediation hints
Change-risk score shown in pipeline UI for every plan with thresholds that can block auto-promotion
Post-apply synthetic health probes for core VPC services that run for configurable window and can trigger automated rollback
CI pipeline integrates Checkov and Terrascan scans and fails on configurable policy violations
Runbook and operator checklist published that documents rollback steps and state-migration commands
steps: Design canary workspace topology and naming convention for Private deployments
Add provider and module version compatibility matrix generator to infra-ci
Implement dry-plan analyzer that parses `terraform plan` output and computes delta risk
Wire Checkov+Terrascan into plan step and surface findings as pipeline annotations
Create post-apply health probe job that exercises networking, KMS access, and core endpoints for 10 minutes
Implement automatic rollback play that runs `terraform apply` with last-known-good plan if probes fail
Add telemetry events for plan/apply outcomes, health-probe results, and rollback reasons
Update docs: runbook, PRD, and on-call playbook; publish Confluence doc and Quickstart example
